name: Kamala Sorokin-Gyasi
role: Information trader and intelligence analyst — broker
location: Steamvent Alley — geothermal district, hot and chemical-smelling, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Kamala Sorokin-Gyasi is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 32, his expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces — and he makes no effort to hide it.

His entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. He works as a broker out of Steamvent Alley, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Kamala Sorokin-Gyasi describe him as a precision instrument — point him at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
coping_mechanisms: Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Kamala Sorokin-Gyasi is slowly going chrome-sick — rejection symptoms are manageable now but getting worse. Has maybe two years before it becomes visible.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
Uses old pre-collapse slang that nobody else remembers
example_lines: "I don't sell information. I sell certainty. Different product, different price."
"Everything has a value. Most people underestimate what they know."
"My sources are confidential. My prices are not."

story_hooks: A crew member from Kamala Sorokin-Gyasi's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A corporate black site Kamala Sorokin-Gyasi once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
A Tier 4 executive offers Kamala Sorokin-Gyasi a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
narrative_function: As a broker, Kamala Sorokin-Gyasi embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces. Reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Semi-independent — recurring contracts with mid-tier fixers

weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown

physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible musculature — the physiology of someone who trains constantly. No wasted mass. Shoulders broad but not bulky. Limbs long and proportionally efficient.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature gray at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and neat, styled back from forehead
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with cool undertones
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, angular jaw. Skin shows the strain of nocturnal living — slightly matte, minor discoloration under eyes. Expression habitually neutral and controlled. Grooming is meticulous but not decorative.
distinguishing_marks: Thin pale scar along left jawline, approximately 8cm, slightly raised — old enough to be well-healed but still visible
Minor burn marks on inner left wrist in a pattern suggesting wire contact — barely noticeable unless pointed out
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Gecko-grip implants visible at fingertips and toe pads — matte black synthetic material with subtle iridescent sheening when light catches them at certain angles. The implants create a subtle geometric texture on skin. No visible spinal augmentation — reflex boosters are internal.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with economical stillness — every micro-movement deliberate. Walks with minimal wasted motion, weight balanced. Hands rest at sides or on lap when seated, fingers rarely fidget. Movements are smooth and precise when engaged. Eye contact is controlled, neither aggressive nor avoidant. Default expression: guarded neutrality.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional wear — dark fitted synthetics, black tactical cargo pants with multiple sealed pockets, lightweight thermal undershirt. Carries a reinforced harness rig for equipment. Boots are matte black with reinforced toe caps (compatible with gecko-grip pads). No visible corp logos or status symbols. Layers suggest someone who works in Steamvent's heat and chemical air — practical, replaceable, purchased for durability not fashion.
